Package grpcdc

Class Dynamic

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.Dynamic
public final class Dynamic extends Object
Dynamic, descriptor-driven client and server.

Parses a FileDescriptorSet (as produced by `protoc --descriptor_set_out`) at runtime and builds clients and servers whose messages are generic field maps — no generated stubs required. Schemas arrive as data (descriptor.proto), not as code.

Generic values by field type: varint family -> Long, string -> String, bytes -> byte[], message -> GenericMessage, fixed/float -> Long/Double/Float, bool -> Boolean.
